original_source_readme_measurement_docum.text: Data supporting:
"Tree species diversity drives aboveground carbon sequestration through light-related trait shifts"
1) DS1.xlsx
Plot-level data including functional diversity, stand biomass
components, and functional traits calculated as
unweighted means and basal-area weighted community-weighted means.
Each row represents one experimental plot.
2) DS2.xlsx
Species-per-plot-level data including woody biomass and functional traits.
Each row represents one species within one experimental plot.
3) DS3.xlsx
Plot-level net diversity effects (NDE) for biomass components and trait-associated responses.
Net diversity effects quantify the relative effect of tree species
mixtures compared to the corresponding monocultures. Positive values
indicate positive diversity effects, whereas negative values indicate
Each row represents one experimental mixture plot.
- block: block identifier within site.
- plot: plot identifier.
- treatment: experimental treatment other than species diversity.
- species_richness: number of tree species per plot.
- species_composition: identity of all tree species present in the plot.
TABLE 1: PLOT-LEVEL VARIABLES
Functional diversity:
- fdis: functional dispersion (FDis) calculated at the plot level, based on species-level LAI, WD, LNCM, SLA and annual height increment.
Biomass variables:
- biomass_woody: aboveground woody biomass at the plot level (Mg ha-1).
- biomass_litterfall: annual litterfall biomass at the plot level (Mg ha-1 yr-1).
- biomass_understory: aboveground understory biomass at the plot level (Mg ha-1).
Specific leaf area (SLA)
- SLA_mean_unweighted: specific leaf area, calculated as the arithmetic mean across species within a plot (cm2 g-1).
- SLA_mean_BA_weighted: specific leaf area, calculated as a community-weighted mean using species basal area as weights (cm2 g-1).
Wood density (WD)
- WD_mean_unweighted: wood density, arithmetic mean across species within a plot (kg m-3).
- WD_mean_BA_weighted: wood density, basal-area weighted mean across species within a plot (kg m-3).
Leaf nutrient concentrations
- LNCM_mean_unweighted: mass-based leaf nitrogen concentration, arithmetic mean across species (%).
- LNCM_mean_BA_weighted: mass-based leaf nitrogen concentration, basal-area weighted mean (%).
- LNCA_mean_unweighted: area-based leaf nitrogen concentration, arithmetic mean across species (g m-2).
- LNCA_mean_BA_weighted: area-based leaf nitrogen concentration, basal-area weighted mean (g m-2).
- LPCM_mean_unweighted: mass-based leaf phosphorus concentration, arithmetic mean across species (%).
- LPCM_mean_BA_weighted: mass-based leaf phosphorus concentration, basal-area weighted mean (%).
Leaf stoichiometry
- CN_leaf_mean_unweighted: leaf carbon to nitrogen ratio, arithmetic mean across species (unitless).
- CN_leaf_mean_BA_weighted: leaf carbon to nitrogen ratio, basal-area weighted mean (unitless).
- NP_leaf_mean_unweighted: leaf nitrogen to phosphorus ratio, arithmetic mean across species (unitless).
- NP_leaf_mean_BA_weighted: leaf nitrogen to phosphorus ratio, basal-area weighted mean (unitless).
Tree height
- height_mean: mean tree height per plot (m).
- height_increment_mean: mean annual height increment per plot (m yr-1).
Canopy cover
- LAI: leaf area index at the plot level (m2 m-2).
TABLE 2: SPECIES-PER-PLOT-LEVEL VARIABLES (DS2)
Species identity:
- species: taxonomic identity of the focal tree species.
Tree biomass:
- biomass_woody: aboveground woody biomass of the focal species within
the plot (Mg ha-1).
Specific leaf area (SLA)
- SLA: species-level specific leaf area (cm2 g-1).
Wood density (WD)
- WD: species-level wood density (kg m-3).
Leaf nutrient concentrations
- LNCM: species-level mass-based leaf nitrogen concentration (%).
- LNCA: species-level area-based leaf nitrogen concentration (g m-2).
- LPCM: species-level mass-based leaf phosphorus concentration (%).
Tree height
- height_increment: species-level mean annual height increment within the plot (m yr-1).
Functional diversity:
- fdis: functional dispersion (FDis) calculated at the plot level, based on species-level LAI, WD, LNCM, SLA and annual height increment.
Net diversity effects (NDE):
- NDE_tree_biomass_unweighted: net diversity effect on aboveground woody biomass.
- NDE_litterfall_unweighted: net diversity effect on litterfall biomass.
- NDE_understory_unweighted: net diversity effect on understory biomass.
- NDE_LAI_unweighted: net diversity effect on leaf area index.
Details of experimental design, sampling protocols, trait measurements,
and statistical analyses are provided in the associated publication.
community-weighted means (CWM), and "_unweighted" denotes arithmetic means

MISSING VALUES
Missing values are coded as n.a.
